language_evidence: Song originates from the Malan Amis community (Falangaw, Taitung). Lu Jingzi is a known Amis performer. Oral tradition roots documented within the Amis community.
ethnic_group_evidence: Linked to Malan Tribe (Falangaw), Taitung. Reflects Amis matrilineal social dynamics and autonomy.
source_snippets: Alternate titles: 馬蘭山歌, 山地情歌, 離別故鄉. Earliest known recording by Lin Ba-zhong & Chen Yue-he (1961). Mandarin adaptation by Mei Dai popularized melody. Difang Duana & Malan Singers on Circle of Life (1998).
verification_notes: Multiple performers and eras; Lu Jingzi 1969 is the reference Amis version. As a protected cultural expression, care should be taken to distinguish from the Elders’ Drinking Song.
